candidates.title: Floating Ball
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a painted ball floated away just as the river began rising before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they reached with a long stick, but the fast current pushed it farther; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the shallower bend downstream was blocked by reeds that could hold it; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they waited at the bend and pulled the ball ashore with a safe rope, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Sunburned Flower
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the newly planted flower curled its petals under the harsh sun before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they poured extra water, but its leaves continued drying in the heat; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a woven basket could shade the plant without stopping the breeze; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they raised the basket on stakes and helped the flower bloom again, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Rattling Parcel
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a fragile gift box began rattling on the way to the celebration before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they hurried onward, but the rattling grew worse on every uneven stone; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the wrapping had shifted and left a delicate ornament unprotected; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they repacked the box with soft cloth and completed the delivery carefully, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
